rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a camera whose live video can be viewed over a network.

example.english: I use a webcam to chat with my family.
example.traditional: 我用網絡攝影機同屋企人傾偈。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 mong5 lok6 sip3 jing2 gei1 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 king1 gai2

rows.note: A speaker uses this when referring more specifically to the webcam hardware or lens, rather than emphasizing the camera as a device.

example.english: The webcam on this computer is broken and can't capture me.
example.traditional: 呢部電腦嘅網絡鏡頭壞咗，影唔到我。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 mong5 lok6 geng3 tau4 waai6 zo2 jing2 m4 dou3 ngo5
